subject.title: Seed design system for OpenClaw Windows Hub

question: Should `.agents/design/` be an authoritative design-intent layer that shipping WinUI/Reactor surfaces must follow, or a derived reference that must follow shipping native behavior?
rationale: The latest revision selects an upstream design-authority model rather than only documenting the existing native implementation, and code review cannot safely establish that permanent repository contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Derived Native Reference
options.body: Keep shipping WinUI/Reactor behavior canonical and require the catalog to mirror it under an explicitly assigned synchronization owner.

options.title: Authoritative Design Intent
options.body: Accept the catalog as upstream authority and define the mandatory review, porting, compatibility, and synchronization process for shipping surfaces.

options.title: Decline Parallel Catalog
options.body: Keep native implementation and tests as the sole UI contract and do not add a separately maintained agent-consumed design catalog.

recommendation.title: Derived Native Reference
recommendation.body: Keep shipping WinUI/Reactor behavior canonical and require the catalog to mirror it under an explicitly assigned synchronization owner.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest identified history in the native chat design language modeled by the largest and most consequential part of the catalog.
